The algoithm will stop after a sufficient number of iterations.

metadata.value: Secret Santa is a way for people to exchange gifts but where each person only knows who he/she has to give a gift to. But one can assume that not all assignments are possible. For example, one can want an assignment where parents can not be assigned to their own children or where colleagues in a company have to be assigned to people working in another department. If we assume the the various possibilities are summed up in a graph G (an arc between A->B indicates that A can offer a gift to B) then the problem is to find a Vertex Cycle Cover of G.
